name: Tessera
summary:
Most video players on Quest give you one screen. Tessera gives you as many as your headset can decode, and lets you put them wherever you like.

Start in a 2D window as a tiled wall, then press Immersive and the same videos lift out into the room around you; grab a screen, push it back, pull it in, grow it, curve it. What's playing keeps playing across the switch.

WHERE YOUR VIDEO COMES FROM

- Files already on the headset
- USB drives; including NTFS and exFAT drives Horizon OS won't mount itself
- SMB /
